title: Inconsistent behavior when opening a file with `fs::Dir`
author: RalfJung
body_preview: On Unix, `fs::Dir::open` on a file fails with `ErrorKind::NotADirectory`. On Windows, it succeeds.  Should we make behavior more consistent than that?  Tracking issue: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/120426

title: Rustup proxy slowdown with Rust-Analyzer
author: stefnotch
body_preview: ### Problem  When Rust-Analyzer runs cargo, then it goes through the rustup proxy. Then, the rustup proxy checks which rust toolchain needs to be used. It then calls the correct version of cargo or rustc.  However, this rustup proxy comes with a quite a bit of overhead. Luckily cargo implements a fast path to skip the proxy for subsequent calls.  https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/blob/cc740019093...
